2. Petitioner's father was employee as Ward
Boy in Primary Health Centre Mundlana,
Gurukul Narsan, Tehsil Roorkee, District
Haridwar, who died while in service on
30.12.2022.
3. Petitioner applied for compassionate
appointment. His request was rejected by Joint
Director, Medical Health, Garhwal Region vide
order dated 28.11.2025. Petitioner thereafter
made another representation questioning the
validity and ground taken for rejection of his
representation.
4. It was contended by the petitioner that
rejection of his request only on the ground that
his brother is employed under the State is
unsustainable and as per the Rules,
compassionate appointment can be denied only
if one of the spouse of the deceased government
is employed under the State or Central
Government.
5. The representation made on 01.12.2025 is

2026:UHC:255
said to be pending before the Joint Director.
Petitioner has sought a direction to the Joint
Director to take decision on the said
representation.
6. Having regard to the facts of the case, the
writ petition is disposed of by permitting the
petitioner to make fresh representation to the
Joint Director. If he makes such representation
within two weeks from today, decision
thereupon shall be taken, as per law, within four
months thereafter.
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 06.01.2026 Mahinder/
